title: Side Hustles
blurb: Turn a skill into income, and keep it legal.
cards: A side hustle is income from something you do on the side: tutoring, design, reselling, content, repairs. The skill is turning something you are good at into something people pay for.
What should you work out before pricing a service?
Your costs and the time it takes
The highest price you can imagine
Your price must cover your costs and your time, or you are paying to work.
Money from a side hustle is usually still taxable income.
Many places expect you to declare self-employed income. Check your local rules and keep records.
Save invoices, receipts and a simple sheet of money in and out. It makes taxes easy, proves your income when you apply for loans, and shows which work is worth doing.
You sell 500 of items and spent 350 on supplies. What is your profit?
A client asks you to start before agreeing a price. What is the smart move?
Agree price and scope first, ideally in writing
A clear agreement prevents unpaid work and arguments.
example: If a weekend service brings in $200 but supplies and travel cost $55, track those costs too. Revenue is not the same as money left to use.
